title: Sponsorships & Partnerships | CAPIT
description: Sponsor CAPIT's public well-plugging registry, partner on source-linked well data, or build on the registry for your organization.
headline: Sponsorships & Partnerships
body: CAPIT publishes source-linked, time-stamped well-plugging records and mints one token on Base for each published plugged-well record. If your organization funds plugging work, supplies well records, or wants its name attached to transparent well-plugging reporting, there's a place for you here.

sections.heading: Sponsorships
sections.body: Sponsors help cover the ongoing cost of collecting, checking, and publishing public well-plugging records. Sponsor recognition appears alongside the national snapshot and state rankings. Sponsors have no influence over which records are published or how they are counted.
bullets: Quarterly summary of records published during your sponsorship

sections.heading: Partners
sections.body: Partners contribute data, tools, or verification capacity. If you run a state registry feed, a plugging service, or a methane measurement service, we'd like to talk about bringing your records into the pipeline.
bullets: Direct file or API record submission
Source attribution on every record you supply
Joint review of verification and publication rules

sections.heading: Clients
sections.body: Organizations that need auditable, source-linked evidence of well-plugging activity can build on the same registry that powers this site.
bullets: Revision history for corrected or withdrawn source records

sections.heading: What We Do Not Offer
sections.body: CAPIT publishes informational content and protocol materials. Nothing on this page is an offer to sell securities, an investment solicitation, or a guarantee of token value. Please review the methodology, disclosures, and contract details before using any wallet or token feature.
